scope: Direct-exit Linux gate of the ENTITY_SCAN cutover (fourth slice): the sector window, the traversal, the exclusions and the first-hit end are the host's; the campaign serves the host's cursor over its own sector lists. Compiled C, Rust and the model-provider protocol changed; Lua is unchanged. Not a native, Windows or retail run: the campaign driver against the real heap getters is exercised natively only.

characterisation_before_change.meaning: the candidate differential (10 tests) and the C control, green on the clean source before the enumeration was replaced

new_checks.entity_candidate_host: 13 tests: the new differential of the ORIGINAL scan (window arithmetic, x outer z inner, tail-first lists, exclusions, first hit, services, poses, refusals) against the host-driven scan over a 4 x 4 map, 400 worlds x 6 segments; kernel contracts for the window, the clamp, the order, the phases and the refusals
new_checks.entity_dialogue: C control, 315 expectations: the REAL driver (mb_hostscan.h) and the REAL exchange over scripted sector lists: tail-first order, first hit, an unnamed sector never read, exclusion facts, an empty list; each illegal state, cursor (raw-word classification, signalling NaN included) and a runaway host by marker
new_checks.bridge_engine_provider: eech-dc 2 + eech-engine 2 + eech-world provider 1 new tests for the ENTITY_SCAN transport
new_checks.entity_host_guard: 5 tests: the ordinary module returns the host-driven scan before the original window and loops, which stay under the original branch; the driver header holds none of the window arithmetic

mutation_controls.meaning: seven mutants (window not widened, map clamp missing, first hit not ending the scan, exclusion ignored, z outer / x inner, list served from the head, exclusion never reported) each failed their check (exit 101) and each file was restored byte for byte

failed_logs_retained: focused1 (a wrong expected getter log in the first exclusion case)
clippy1 and clippy2 (a complex type and two indexing lints in new tests)

code_inputs.meaning: filtered = Git blob id as the clean filter would store each working file; raw = SHA-256 of the raw working bytes; three pre-existing CRLF files keep the documented qualification; no accepted file was normalised
